title: Peppy: An AI-Assisted Workflow for Tight Convergence Analysis of Optimization Algorithms
authors: Jaewook J. Suh, TaeHo Yoon, Edward Duc Hien Nguyen et al.
abstract: This paper presents Peppy, an AI-assisted workflow for discovering tight, analytic convergence proofs for first-order optimization algorithms. Generic approaches to using LLMs to conduct mathematical research target an unspecified, broad spectrum of problems and sometimes use the Lean 4 proof assistant for formalization.
